   246	
   247	def record_entry(
   248	    conn: sqlite3.Connection, req: EntryRequest, *,
   249	    soft_warn: int, hard_cap: int, force: bool,
   250	    cfg=None,
   251	) -> EntryResult:
   252	    """22-A adds ONE keyword-only parameter, ``cfg``, and that is the whole
   253	    signature change in the arc.  Both production call sites already have it
   254	    (``swing/cli.py``, ``swing/web/routes/trades.py``).
   255	
   256	    ``cfg=None`` DECLINES the latch path with reason ``no_config`` and leaves
   257	    every persisted value byte-identical to the pre-arc behaviour, so every
   258	    pre-existing caller and test is unaffected.
   259	    """
   260	    # Phase 7 Sub-B B.1 — non-bypassable pre-trade required-field gate. Per
   261	    # spec §9.3, MissingPreTradeFieldsException is NOT force-bypassable; it
   262	    # fires BEFORE the existing stop / duplicate / cap checks so an operator
   263	    # can never sneak a partial-state row past the lock by toggling --force.
   264	    # The validator's required-field set + conditional rules live in
   265	    # ``swing.trades.state``; this service just calls + raises.
   266	    #
   267	    # Note: the validator's "always required" set includes `trade_origin` +
   268	    # `pre_trade_locked_at`, which the route/CLI layer doesn't populate on
   269	    # EntryRequest. `pre_trade_locked_at` still uses an interim shim
   270	    # (event_ts); the canonical atomic insert+fill flow lands at B.3.
   271	    #
   272	    # B.2: `trade_origin` is now derived BEFORE validation via the origin
   273	    # service so the validator and the eventual INSERT see the same value
   274	    # the row will be persisted with. The 4-value enum returned by
   275	    # derive_trade_origin always satisfies the validator's required-field
   276	    # check (non-NULL string), so this preserves the gate-fires-first
   277	    # discipline regardless of (bucket × entry_path) combo.
   278	    derived_origin = derive_trade_origin(conn, req.ticker, req.entry_path)
   279	    req_view: dict = {
   280	        f: getattr(req, f, None)
   281	        for f in (
   282	            "ticker", "entry_date", "entry_price", "initial_stop",
   283	            "thesis", "why_now", "invalidation_condition", "expected_scenario",
   284	            "premortem_technical", "premortem_market_sector",
   285	            "premortem_execution", "event_risk_present", "event_handling",
   286	            "event_type", "event_date", "gap_risk_present",
   287	            "gap_risk_handling", "emotional_state_pre_trade",
   288	            "market_regime", "catalyst", "catalyst_other_description",
   289	            "manual_entry_confidence",
   290	        )
   291	    }
   292	    req_view["initial_shares"] = req.shares
   293	    req_view["trade_origin"] = derived_origin
   294	    # Codex R4 Major 1: pre_trade_locked_at + first-fill datetime must
   295	    # reflect when the trade actually entered the market (req.entry_date),
   296	    # not when the operator typed the command (req.event_ts).
   297	    # Codex R5 Major 1: trades.entry_date column is date-only and downstream
   298	    # consumers (advisory, journal/flags+analyze, briefing, CLI hold-duration)
   299	    # call date.fromisoformat(trade.entry_date) directly. So entry_date must
   300	    # remain YYYY-MM-DD only at the API boundary; reject T-form before
   301	    # storing. Synthesis of T16:00:00 for fill_datetime / pre_trade_locked_at
   302	    # happens via the shared helper after the date-only guard.
   303	    from swing.trades.exit import _normalize_trade_event_date_to_iso
   304	    if "T" in req.entry_date:
   305	        raise ValueError(
   306	            f"entry_date {req.entry_date!r} must be YYYY-MM-DD only "
   307	            f"(not a full ISO datetime); the trades.entry_date column is "
   308	            f"date-only and downstream consumers (advisory, journal, "
   309	            f"briefing, CLI hold-duration) call date.fromisoformat on it"
   310	        )
   311	    entry_iso = _normalize_trade_event_date_to_iso(
   312	        req.entry_date, field_name="entry_date",
   313	    )
   314	    req_view["pre_trade_locked_at"] = entry_iso
   315	    missing = validate_for_operation(req_view, op="entry_create", current_state=None)
   316	    if missing:
   317	        raise MissingPreTradeFieldsException(missing_fields=missing)
   318	
   319	    if req.initial_stop >= req.entry_price:
   320	        raise ValueError(
   321	            f"stop must be < entry; got entry={req.entry_price}, stop={req.initial_stop}"
   322	        )
   323	
   324	    # 20-A B-2 (Codex R11 MAJOR): the entry write-gate does NOT exclude voided
   325	    # trades. The B-2 void is a disposition for CLOSED/reviewed phantom trades
   326	    # (SATL is reviewed); a voided-but-OPEN trade is out of V1 scope -- the
   327	    # note-void does not transition state, and the DB partial unique index
   328	    # `ux_trades_one_open_per_ticker` (migration 0014) still enforces one open
   329	    # position per ticker across ALL open states. Excluding voided here would
   330	    # be a FALSE PROMISE (the Python check would pass, then the INSERT would
   331	    # fail on the index and re-map to DuplicateOpenPositionError). The gate
   332	    # therefore treats all open trades uniformly, consistent with the DB.
   333	    open_trades = list_open_trades(conn)
   334	    if any(t.ticker == req.ticker for t in open_trades):
   335	        raise DuplicateOpenPositionError(
   336	            f"Already an open position in {req.ticker}"
   337	        )
   338	
   339	    open_count = len(open_trades)
   340	    if open_count >= hard_cap:
   341	        raise HardCapError(
   342	            f"Hard cap reached: {open_count} >= {hard_cap}"
   343	        )
   344	    warning: str | None = None
   345	    if open_count >= soft_warn:
   346	        if not force:
   347	            raise SoftWarnError(
   348	                f"Open count {open_count} >= soft warn {soft_warn}; use --force"
   349	            )
   350	        warning = f"Soft warn exceeded: {open_count} open positions (soft={soft_warn})"
   351	
   352	    # Phase 13 T2.SB6c T-A.6c.4 §C.5 Layer 3 + OQ-11 lifecycle —
   353	    # resolve candidate_id from the latest-complete-evaluation-run
   354	    # candidate row for pipeline-origin trades. NULL for
   355	    # manual_off_pipeline (no candidate row exists) OR when the
   356	    # caller already provided one (CLI / E2E paths). Path 1
   357	    # (evaluation_run_id filter) per plan §B.1; we leverage the
   358	    # existing _latest_complete_evaluation_run_id helper.
   359	    #
   360	    # Codex R1 MAJOR #3 closure: when ``req.pattern_evaluation_id`` is
   361	    # non-NULL, resolve ``candidate_id`` via the PE row's
   362	    # ``pipeline_run_id → pipeline_runs.evaluation_run_id`` chain
   363	    # rather than the latest-complete fallback. Without this, a fresh
   364	    # pipeline run landing between form render and POST would corrupt
   365	    # paired backlink semantics: ``pattern_evaluation_id`` validates
   366	    # against the form-render run's id, but ``candidate_id`` would
   367	    # bind to a NEWER run's candidate row for the same ticker.
   368	    # =====================================================================
   369	    # 22-A -- THE LATCH SEAM.  Everything above this line is UNTOUCHED, in
   370	    # its original order, so the LOCK's clause (c) -- every pre-existing
   371	    # failure branch raises the same exception, with the same message, at the
   372	    # same point -- is true by construction rather than by inspection.
   373	    #
   374	    # THE RECOGNITION READ IS OUTSIDE THE TRANSACTION AND QUERY-FREE.  It
   375	    # parses the operator-submitted envelope and nothing else, so a fill with
   376	    # no usable broker order id costs ZERO additional database queries
   377	    # (LOCK clause (d)) and takes the deferred ``with conn:`` exactly as
   378	    # before.
   379	    # =====================================================================
   380	    from swing.trades.latched_origin import envelope_recognises_an_order
   381	
   382	    # THE RECOGNITION QUESTION IS THE RESOLVER'S OWN, NOT A SECOND SPELLING OF
   383	    # IT (self-sweep SS-1).
   384	    #
   385	    # This site asked `broker_order_id_from_envelope(...) is not None`, which
   386	    # is the PYTHON reader alone -- so an envelope Python reads as ABSENT and
   387	    # SQLite reads as a REAL LINKED order took NO reservation, never called the
   388	    # resolver at all, and ran the ordinary current-candidate chain. The
   389	    # canonicality guard 22A-R8-01 added for exactly that disagreement sat
   390	    # behind a door this line never opened. MEASURED end to end on three
   391	    # shapes (duplicate key whose LAST value is null / numeric / empty): the
   392	    # persisted row was `pipeline_aplus` + TODAY's candidate.
   393	    #
   394	    # `envelope_recognises_an_order` is that question asked ONCE, in the
   395	    # module that owns it. It stays a PURE STRING READ, so LOCK clause (d) --
   396	    # a request with no usable order id costs ZERO additional database
   397	    # queries -- is untouched, and so is its subject: an envelope naming no
   398	    # order that both domains read alike is still unrecognised and still takes
   399	    # the deferred `with conn:` exactly as before.
   400	
   401	    # THE ORDER ID IS PARSED WHETHER OR NOT A CONFIG WAS SUPPLIED (Codex
   402	    # 22A-R7-01).
   403	    #
   404	    # AND `cfg=None` IS NO LONGER "THE PRE-ARC PATH" WITHOUT QUALIFICATION
   405	    # (Codex 22A-R9-07): it is the pre-arc path for a request whose envelope
   406	    # resolves to NO LINK. A request whose order IS linked is RECOGNISED and
   407	    # refused, and the row lands honest-unset. Stated here because the earlier
   408	    # unqualified sentence was a security-relevant caller contract that the
   409	    # 22A-R7-01 fix had made false while it still read true (#31).
   410	    #
   411	    # Gating the PARSE on `cfg` meant an order-bearing request
   412	    # from a caller who omitted the config took no reservation, never
   413	    # consulted the link table, and ran the ordinary current-candidate chain
   414	    # -- a wrong ACCEPTANCE reachable by leaving one keyword off. The parse
   415	    # is a pure string read and costs no query, so LOCK clause (d) -- "no
   416	    # usable order id costs ZERO additional database queries" -- is untouched:
   417	    # its subject is a request with NO ORDER ID, and that request still takes
   418	    # the deferred `with conn:` exactly as before.
   419	    _recognised_order_id = envelope_recognises_an_order(
   420	        getattr(req, "schwab_source_value_json", None))
   421	    # THE TRIGGER IS "THE REQUEST CARRIES A USABLE ORDER ID", NEVER "THE
   422	    # RECOGNITION FOUND A LINK" (plan S2.2 rule 3, review 22A-R3-01).  A
   423	    # request whose preliminary answer was NO LINK can acquire a matching
   424	    # validity row before the INSERT and would otherwise take the ordinary
   425	    # path on a stale negative.  A negative result is as perishable as a
   426	    # positive one, and the reservation covers both (case 21b).
   427	    _reserve = _recognised_order_id
   428	    if _reserve and conn.in_transaction:
   429	        raise CallerHeldEntryTransactionError(
   430	            "record_entry owns BEGIN IMMEDIATE for an order-id-bearing "
   431	            "request and REJECTS a caller-held transaction rather than "
   432	            "auto-detecting one; an auto-detect guard re-introduces the race "
   433	            "the explicit lock closed. Nothing was written."
   434	        )
   435	
   436	    with _entry_transaction(conn, immediate=_reserve):
   437	        return _record_entry_inner(
   438	            conn, req,
   439	            cfg=cfg,
   440	            derived_origin=derived_origin,
   441	            entry_iso=entry_iso,
   442	            warning=warning,
   443	            reserve=_reserve,
   444	        )
   445	
   446	
   447	class CallerHeldEntryTransactionError(RuntimeError):
   448	    """``record_entry`` was called with an open transaction on the latched
   449	    path.  Single-transaction services own ``BEGIN IMMEDIATE`` / COMMIT /
   450	    ROLLBACK and REJECT a caller-held transaction (CLAUDE.md)."""
   451	
   452	
   453	@contextlib.contextmanager
   454	def _entry_transaction(conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, immediate: bool):
   455	    """The ONE transaction the entry row is written in.
   456	
   457	    ``immediate=False`` is the pre-arc path, byte-for-byte: Python's sqlite3
   458	    implicit DEFERRED transaction via ``with conn:``.
   459	
   460	    ``immediate=True`` is the latched path.  ``with conn:`` acquires NO write
   461	    reservation until its first write, so a resolution performed "inside" it
   462	    still reads without reserving and another connection can commit between
   463	    that read and the INSERT.  The explicit ``BEGIN IMMEDIATE`` takes the
   464	    reservation FIRST, following Demand C's shape verbatim including its
   465	    caller-held-transaction refusal.
   466	    """
   467	    if not immediate:
   468	        with conn:
   469	            yield
   470	        return
   471	    conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
   472	    try:
   473	        yield
   474	        # THE COMMIT IS INSIDE THE HANDLER'S REACH (Codex 22A-R4-03).  It sat
   475	        # in an `else:` clause, OUTSIDE `except BaseException:` -- so a commit
   476	        # that raises (SQLITE_BUSY, disk-full, I/O) left the transaction AND
   477	        # its write reservation open on a connection the caller goes on
   478	        # reusing.  A failed COMMIT is exactly the moment a rollback matters
   479	        # most, and it was the one path that did not get one.
   480	        conn.commit()
   481	    except BaseException:
   482	        with contextlib.suppress(sqlite3.Error):
   483	            conn.rollback()
   484	        raise
   485	
   486	
   487	def _record_entry_inner(
   488	    conn: sqlite3.Connection, req: EntryRequest, *,
   489	    cfg,
   490	    derived_origin: str,
   491	    entry_iso: str,
   492	    warning: str | None,
   493	    reserve: bool,
   494	) -> EntryResult:
   495	    """Never opens or closes a transaction; the caller owns it.
   496	
   497	    Every read below therefore sees the world the write lands in, which is the
   498	    entire point of the reservation.
   499	    """
   500	    from swing.trades.latched_origin import (
   501	        LatchedProvenance,
   502	        resolve_latched_provenance,
   503	    )
   504	    from swing.trades.origin import _latest_complete_evaluation_run_id
   505	
   506	    resolved_candidate_id: int | None = req.candidate_id
   507	
   508	    if reserve:
   509	        # THE ORIGIN IS RE-DERIVED INSIDE THE RESERVATION (Codex 22A-R4-01).
   510	        # The preliminary value at the call site above is computed BEFORE
   511	        # `BEGIN IMMEDIATE`, so a pipeline run can commit between the two --
   512	        # and that value fed BOTH the persisted ordinary origin AND the PE-
   513	        # anchor guard below, whose comment claimed it read "the world the
   514	        # write lands in".  It did not.  A comment asserting an invariant the
   515	        # code does not hold is worse than no comment, because it reads true
   516	        # (gotcha #31, inside a fix written to avoid it).
   517	        #
   518	        # THE PRELIMINARY VALUE IS STILL LOAD-BEARING and is NOT removed: the
   519	        # validator runs on it, before the reservation, and moving that read
   520	        # would move LOCK clause (c)'s ordering.  The validator requires
   521	        # `trade_origin` for PRESENCE and never keys a rule on its VALUE
   522	        # (pinned by `test_the_validator_never_keys_a_rule_on_the_trade_origin_VALUE`),
   523	        # so the two reads can differ without changing any pre-existing branch.
   524	        #
   525	        # ONLY the reserved path re-derives.  The unreserved path is the
   526	        # pre-arc path byte-for-byte and takes no reservation to be inside of.
   527	        derived_origin = derive_trade_origin(conn, req.ticker, req.entry_path)
   528	
   529	    # THE AUTHORITATIVE RESOLUTION, inside the reservation.  The preliminary
   530	    # answer computed outside it is DISCARDED -- it exists only to decide
   531	    # whether to reserve.
   532	    # THE UNRESERVED BRANCH ASKS THE SAME QUESTION, IN THE SAME WORDS (RD's
   533	    # 22A-R3-13 ruling). An absent envelope names no order, so it takes NO
   534	    # reservation -- LOCK clause (d) -- and therefore never reaches the
   535	    # resolver at all. The inconsistency check is a PURE, query-free predicate
   536	    # for exactly that reason, and it is IMPORTED rather than re-spelled here:
   537	    # two callers answering one question two ways is the class this arc has
   538	    # paid for repeatedly.
   539	    from swing.trades.latched_origin import (
   540	        origin_and_envelope_are_inconsistent,
   541	    )
   542	
   543	    _envelope = getattr(req, "schwab_source_value_json", None)
   544	    if reserve:
   545	        latched = resolve_latched_provenance(conn, cfg, req)
   546	    elif origin_and_envelope_are_inconsistent(
   547	            getattr(req, "fill_origin", "operator_typed"), _envelope):
   548	        log.warning(
   549	            "22-A: fill for %s claims origin %r, which carries a Schwab "
   550	            "envelope BY CONSTRUCTION, and its envelope is ABSENT (%r); no "
   551	            "production writer produces that pair, so the envelope was "
   552	            "stripped, tampered with or corrupted. The entry records with "
   553	            "honest-unset cohort keys rather than with the latest run's "
   554	            "candidate. WARRANTS INVESTIGATION",
   555	            req.ticker, getattr(req, "fill_origin", None), _envelope)
   556	        latched = LatchedProvenance(
   557	            admitted=False, recognised_but_underivable=True,
   558	            decline_reason="origin_envelope_inconsistent")
   559	    else:
   560	        latched = LatchedProvenance(
   561	            admitted=False, recognised_but_underivable=False,
   562	            decline_reason="no_config" if cfg is None else "no_order_id")
   563	
   564	    # THE PE-ANCHOR GUARD, RELOCATED FROM THE ROUTE AND NOT MERELY DEFERRED
   565	    # (review 22A-R9-03).  The route rejects a `pattern_evaluation_id` anchor
   566	    # whose server-derived origin is `manual_off_pipeline`; for order-id-
   567	    # bearing requests the route now defers to here, so WITHOUT this block the
   568	    # deferral would DELETE a live production rejection and the row would be
   569	    # written.  Case 37c is the stable no-link outcome that fails a deferral-
   570	    # without-relocation implementation; every other case in the plan passes
   571	    # one.
   572	    #
   573	    # INSIDE THE TRANSACTION IS THE WHOLE POINT, AND IT IS ONLY TRUE BECAUSE
   574	    # OF THE RE-DERIVATION ABOVE (Codex 22A-R4-01): the guard's input is
   575	    # `derive_trade_origin`, which reads the latest evaluation run -- the same
   576	    # world the race can move.  Relocating the guard inside the transaction
   577	    # while it judged the value computed OUTSIDE bought nothing; the comment
   578	    # read true and the code did not hold it.  What makes the claim honest is
   579	    # that `derived_origin` is re-read under the reservation, so the value the
   580	    # guard judges is the value the row is written with.
   581	    #
   582	    # AND IT FIRES ON THE ORDINARY PATH ONLY (RD, ruled 2026-08-25).  The
   583	    # condition was `not latched.admitted`, and `recognised_but_underivable`
   584	    # IS a not-admitted state -- so an entry whose mandate the ladder
   585	    # RECOGNISED and REFUSED was blocked, and no row was written.  That is the
   586	    # COHORT-GUARD REFUSES: ENTRY -- and it is the ONE declared exception,
   587	    # ruled by RD: this is a PRE-EXISTING production rejection RELOCATED
   588	    # from the route (22A-R9-03), not a cohort-provenance guard, and it
   589	    # fires on the ORDINARY path only.  Pinned at
   590	    # `test_THE_DECLARED_EXCEPTION_the_pe_anchor_guard_still_bites_on_the_ordinary_path`.
   591	    #
   592	    # `0036:26-38` inversion: **cohort bookkeeping never blocks a
   593	    # money-bearing entry.**  A refusal here is about the LABEL, never about
   594	    # the ENTRY, so `recognised_but_underivable` is not-admitted AND must pass
   595	    # through to the honest-unset row.  One clause too wide, the same class
   596	    # this arc has already paid for twice.
   597	    #
   598	    # CASE 37c IS UNAFFECTED and is what proves the guard still bites: an
   599	    # UNMATCHED order id leaves BOTH flags false, so the ordinary path runs
   600	    # and the guard refuses exactly as the route does today.
   601	    if (
   602	        reserve
   603	        and not latched.admitted
   604	        and not latched.recognised_but_underivable
   605	        and req.pattern_evaluation_id is not None
   606	        and derived_origin == "manual_off_pipeline"
   607	    ):
   608	        raise PatternEvaluationAnchorError(_PE_ANCHOR_MESSAGE)
   609	
   610	    hypothesis_label = req.hypothesis_label
   611	    if latched.admitted:
   612	        # ALL THREE KEYS MOVE TOGETHER (plan S2.6).  A row carrying origin and
   613	        # candidate but a NULL label is incoherent AND permanently
   614	        # uncorrectable: Demand C's `_gate_on_unset_state` refuses a trade
   615	        # carrying any of the three.
   616	        log.info(
   617	            "22-A: fill for %s admitted from latched mandate %s (link %s, "
   618	            "order %s, validity intent %s); writing trade_origin=%s "
   619	            "candidate_id=%s",
   620	            req.ticker, latched.candidate_id,
   621	            latched.order.link_id if latched.order else None,
   622	            latched.order.broker_order_id if latched.order else None,
   623	            latched.order.validity_intent_id if latched.order else None,
   624	            latched.trade_origin, latched.candidate_id,
   625	        )
   626	        if req.candidate_id is not None and req.candidate_id != latched.candidate_id:
   627	            log.warning(
   628	                "22-A: caller-supplied candidate_id %s disagrees with the "
   629	                "latched fire %s for %s; THE LATCH WINS -- it is keyed to a "
   630	                "broker-accepted order rather than to a form render",
   631	                req.candidate_id, latched.candidate_id, req.ticker)
   632	        derived_origin = latched.trade_origin
   633	        resolved_candidate_id = latched.candidate_id
   634	        hypothesis_label = latched.hypothesis_label
   635	    elif latched.recognised_but_underivable:
   636	        # THE HONEST-UNSET ROW, and the ordinary candidate/origin chain is
   637	        # SUPPRESSED rather than allowed to fall back.  For a ticker that is
   638	        # `aplus` in TODAY's latest run the ordinary chain would write
   639	        # `pipeline_aplus` plus TODAY's candidate -- a DIFFERENT mandate from
   640	        # the one this fill demonstrably came from.  Silent-wrong, not
   641	        # honest-NULL (case 12).
   642	        log.warning(
   643	            "22-A: a latched mandate was RECOGNISED for %s (order %s) and "
   644	            "REFUSED (%s); the entry records honest-unset cohort keys rather "
   645	            "than the latest run's candidate, and the submitted "
   646	            "hypothesis_label %r is discarded -- a non-NULL label would make "
   647	            "the row permanently uncorrectable",
   648	            req.ticker,
   649	            latched.order.broker_order_id if latched.order else None,
   650	            latched.decline_reason, req.hypothesis_label)
   651	        derived_origin = "manual_off_pipeline"
   652	        resolved_candidate_id = None
   653	        hypothesis_label = None
   654	
   655	    if latched.admitted or latched.recognised_but_underivable:
   656	        pass                      # the ordinary chain is not consulted
   657	    elif resolved_candidate_id is None and derived_origin != "manual_off_pipeline":
   658	        _eval_run_for_candidate: int | None = None
   659	        if req.pattern_evaluation_id is not None:
   660	            _chain_row = conn.execute(
   661	                "SELECT pr.evaluation_run_id FROM pattern_evaluations pe "
   662	                "JOIN pipeline_runs pr ON pr.id = pe.pipeline_run_id "
   663	                "WHERE pe.id = ?",
   664	                (int(req.pattern_evaluation_id),),
   665	            ).fetchone()
   666	            if _chain_row is not None and _chain_row[0] is not None:
   667	                _eval_run_for_candidate = int(_chain_row[0])
   668	        if _eval_run_for_candidate is None:
   669	            _eval_run_for_candidate = _latest_complete_evaluation_run_id(conn)
   670	        if _eval_run_for_candidate is not None:
   671	            _cand_row = conn.execute(
   672	                "SELECT id FROM candidates "
   673	                "WHERE evaluation_run_id = ? AND ticker = ? "
   674	                "ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1",
   675	                (_eval_run_for_candidate, req.ticker),
   676	            ).fetchone()
   677	            if _cand_row is not None:
   678	                resolved_candidate_id = int(_cand_row[0])
   679	
   680	    trade = Trade(
   681	        id=None, ticker=req.ticker, entry_date=req.entry_date,
   682	        entry_price=req.entry_price, initial_shares=req.shares,
   683	        initial_stop=req.initial_stop, current_stop=req.initial_stop,
   684	        # Phase 7: state lifecycle replaces the legacy `status` column.
   685	        # New entries land in 'entered'; the state-mutation service
   686	        # transitions to 'managing' once the first non-entry fill arrives.
   687	        state="entered",
   688	        watchlist_entry_target=req.watchlist_entry_target,
   689	        watchlist_initial_stop=req.watchlist_initial_stop,
   690	        notes=req.notes,
   691	        hypothesis_label=canonicalize_hypothesis_label(hypothesis_label),
   692	        # Snapshot AS-IS — no re-resolve here (spec §3.6 ToCToU fix).
   693	        # The operator override re-uses canonicalize_hypothesis_label
   694	        # because spec §3.6 specifies identical NFC + control-byte rules
   695	        # for both free-text labels.
   696	        chart_pattern_algo=req.chart_pattern_algo,
   697	        chart_pattern_algo_confidence=req.chart_pattern_algo_confidence,
   698	        chart_pattern_operator=canonicalize_hypothesis_label(req.chart_pattern_operator),
   699	        chart_pattern_classification_pipeline_run_id=req.chart_pattern_classification_pipeline_run_id,
   700	        sector=req.sector,
   900	                submitted_schwab_source_value_json=schwab_source_value_json,
   901	                submitted_auto_fill_audit_at=auto_fill_audit_at,
   902	                submitted_fill_origin_at_form_render=fill_origin_at_form_render,
   903	            )
   904	
   905	    # Phase 7 Sub-C C.3 — emotional_state_pre_trade JSON-encoding.
   906	    # Matches CLI's `_json.dumps(list(emotional_state))` (swing/cli.py).
   907	    # Empty list / None → None so the validator's required-field check
   908	    # fires (NULL is treated as missing). Drops empty strings so a
   909	    # bare-cURL POST submitting "emotional_state_pre_trade=" doesn't
   910	    # encode `[""]` and dodge the gate.
   911	    import json as _json
   912	    emo_clean = [
   913	        s for s in (emotional_state_pre_trade or []) if s and s.strip()
   914	    ]
   915	    emo_json: str | None = _json.dumps(emo_clean) if emo_clean else None
   916	
   917	    # Phase 13 T3.SB1 T-B.1.4 — fill_origin transition resolution.
   918	    # Compare submitted entry_date / entry_price / shares against the
   919	    # form-render anchor (``schwab_source_value_json`` JSON envelope).
   920	    # Three outcomes:
   921	    #   - No anchor (empty/missing JSON) → operator_typed; all audit
   922	    #     columns NULL.
   923	    #   - Anchor matches submitted values exactly → schwab_auto.
   924	    #   - Anchor differs from submitted values (operator edited any of
   925	    #     the 3 fields) → schwab_auto_then_operator_corrected;
   926	    #     ``operator_corrected_value_json`` carries the submitted values.
   927	    # Per spec §6.1 + §6.4 + plan §G.2 T-B.1.4 + brief §5 watch item 10.
   928	    resolved_fill_origin = "operator_typed"
   929	    resolved_schwab_source_value_json: str | None = None
   930	    resolved_operator_corrected_value_json: str | None = None
   931	    resolved_auto_fill_audit_at: str | None = None
   932	    # Codex R1 Major #1 + #2 fix — consistency check across the 3 hidden
   933	    # anchors (schwab_source_value_json + auto_fill_audit_at +
   934	    # fill_origin_at_form_render). When the operator claims
   935	    # fill_origin_at_form_render='schwab_auto' (or
   936	    # 'schwab_auto_then_operator_corrected') but the anchor JSON envelope
   937	    # is missing / empty / malformed, the POST is internally inconsistent
   938	    # — either a tampered submit OR a stale form (operator submitted the
   939	    # page after server-side state evicted). Reject with 400 + descriptive
   940	    # error so the operator re-renders. The legacy / bare-cURL backward-
   941	    # compat path (no anchor, no claim) still flows through as
   942	    # operator_typed.
   943	    # Codex R3 Minor #1 fix — normalize ``fill_origin_at_form_render``
   944	    # via ``.strip()`` ONCE here so the same canonical value is consulted
   945	    # by both the consistency-check predicate (``claimed_auto_fill``) and
   946	    # the re-render preservation kwargs (`submitted_*`). Without this,
   947	    # whitespace-padded input could be treated as auto-fill for validation
   948	    # purposes but not restored as populated on retry.
   949	    fill_origin_at_form_render = fill_origin_at_form_render.strip()
   950	    claimed_auto_fill = fill_origin_at_form_render in (
   951	        "schwab_auto", "schwab_auto_then_operator_corrected",
   952	    )
   953	    if schwab_source_value_json.strip():
   954	        try:
   955	            anchor_envelope = _json.loads(schwab_source_value_json)
   956	        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 -- the TYPE ROSTER is the failure
   957	            # Codex 22A-R10-04, and the MISS was this arc's own.  SS-2 stated
   958	            # the class -- enumerating the types `json.loads` can raise is the
   959	            # hand-maintained-roster failure 22A-R8-03 ruled against -- and

     1	"""Phase 13 T3.SB1 T-B.1.2 — entry auto-fill via Schwab Trader API.
     2	
     3	``resolve_entry_auto_fill(*, ticker, cfg, conn, now=None, lookback_days=7)``
     4	is called from the ``/trades/entry/form`` route handler at form-render
     5	time. It resolves recent BUY-side fills for ``ticker`` via the Schwab
     6	Trader API and returns an ``EntryAutoFillResult`` that the route handler
     7	maps to ``TradeEntryFormVM`` fields.
     8	
     9	Schwab integration discipline (4-step chain BINDING per spec §6.1 + plan
    10	§A.11 + CLAUDE.md gotcha "Schwab integration discipline" + dispatch brief
    11	§5 watch items 3, 4, 5):
    12	
    13	  1. Caller has run ``apply_overrides(cfg)`` at handler entry. The service
    14	     consumes the already-merged ``cfg``; it does NOT re-apply overrides.
    15	  2. ``resolve_credentials_env_or_prompt(cfg, environment, allow_prompt=False)``
    16	     — ``allow_prompt=False`` BINDING per CLAUDE.md gotcha "form-render-time
    17	     prompts would block HTTP handler".
    18	  3. ``construct_authenticated_client(cfg, environment, client_id, client_secret)``
    19	     — 4-arg signature per post-Phase-12 Sub-bundle 1 + forward-binding
    20	     lesson #10.
    21	  4. ``trader.get_account_orders(client, conn, account_hash, from_dt, to_dt,
    22	     surface='trade_entry', environment=environment, ...)`` — emits the
    23	     ``schwab_api_calls`` audit row internally via ``audit_service`` per
    24	     CHECK widening at v20 migration.
    25	
    26	Short-circuits (any of which skip steps 2-4):
    27	
    28	  - Sandbox: ``cfg.integrations.schwab.environment == 'sandbox'`` →
    29	    ``kind='sandbox_short_circuit'`` per CLAUDE.md "Schwab API integration
    30	    writes domain rows ONLY when environment='production'".
    31	  - DEGRADED / PROVISIONAL: ``cli_schwab._compute_degraded_state`` returns
    32	    non-``LIVE`` → ``kind='degraded'``. Mirrors the ``swing schwab status``
    33	    predicate so operator sees consistent state across surfaces.
    34	  - account_hash missing: ``cfg.integrations.schwab.account_hash`` absent
    35	    or non-string → ``kind='degraded'``.
    36	  - Credentials absent under ``allow_prompt=False``: returns ``(None, None)``
    37	    → ``kind='degraded'``.
    38	
    39	Execution-grain helpers consumed verbatim from post-Phase-12 Sub-bundle 1
    40	(``swing/trades/schwab_reconciliation.py``):
    41	
    42	  - ``_compute_execution_price`` — single-leg / multi-leg VWAP.
    43	  - ``_resolve_match_quantity`` — execution-grain quantity (or fallback to
    44	    ``so.quantity`` for legacy V1 mapper paths).
    45	  - ``_is_execution_bearing_candidate`` — FILLED with executions OR price
    46	    set, CANCELED with executions (partial-then-canceled), REPLACED with
    47	    executions (partial-then-replaced).

   121	@dataclass(frozen=True)
   122	class EntryAutoFillResult:
   123	    """Result of ``resolve_entry_auto_fill`` (form-render-time fetch).
   124	
   125	    Five disjoint ``kind`` values:
   126	
   127	      - ``'populated'``: Schwab returned a matching BUY fill. Fields carry
   128	        execution-grain values; ``fill_origin='schwab_auto'``.
   129	      - ``'empty'``: Schwab returned no matching BUY fill. Fields are None;
   130	        ``fill_origin='operator_typed'``; ``advisory_text`` non-None.
   131	      - ``'sandbox_short_circuit'``: ``cfg.integrations.schwab.environment
   132	        == 'sandbox'``. NO Schwab call fired. Fields are None;
   133	        ``fill_origin='operator_typed'``; ``advisory_text`` non-None.
   134	      - ``'degraded'``: DEGRADED / PROVISIONAL state OR account_hash
   135	        unresolvable OR credential resolution returned None. NO Schwab call
   136	        fired. Fields are None; ``fill_origin='operator_typed'``;
   137	        ``advisory_text`` non-None.
   138	      - ``'error'``: Schwab call fired but raised a typed exception
   139	        (``SchwabApiError`` / ``SchwabAuthError`` / ``SchwabRateLimitError``).
   140	        Audit row records the failure outcome via the existing
   141	        ``audit_service`` plumbing. Fields are None;
   142	        ``fill_origin='operator_typed'``; ``advisory_text`` non-None.
   143	
   144	    Hidden audit anchors ``schwab_source_value_json`` + ``auto_fill_audit_at``
   145	    are server-stamped at form render (per CLAUDE.md "For any V1 single-
   146	    operator form with hidden audit fields, default to SERVER-STAMPING at
   147	    handler entry; hidden inputs are tampering surfaces"):
   148	
   149	      - ``schwab_source_value_json``: JSON-encoded original auto-populated
   150	        values. Set on ``'populated'`` only; None for other kinds.
   151	      - ``auto_fill_audit_at``: ISO timestamp at form-render time. Set on
   152	        ALL kinds (even short-circuit kinds — the audit anchor records
   153	        that an auto-fill ATTEMPT happened at this time).
   154	    """
   155	
   156	    kind: EntryAutoFillKind
   157	    fill_origin: EntryFillOrigin = "operator_typed"
   158	    entry_date: str | None = None
   159	    entry_price: float | None = None
   160	    shares: int | None = None
   161	    advisory_text: str | None = None
   162	    schwab_source_value_json: str | None = None
   163	    auto_fill_audit_at: str | None = None
   164	    schwab_api_call_id: int | None = None
   165	
   166	    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
   167	        if self.kind == "populated":
   168	            if self.entry_date is None:
   169	                raise ValueError(
   170	                    "populated EntryAutoFillResult requires entry_date"
   171	                )
   172	            if self.entry_price is None:
   173	                raise ValueError(
   174	                    "populated EntryAutoFillResult requires entry_price"
   175	                )
   176	            if self.shares is None:
   177	                raise ValueError(
   178	                    "populated EntryAutoFillResult requires shares"
   179	                )
   180	            if self.fill_origin != "schwab_auto":
   181	                raise ValueError(
   182	                    "populated EntryAutoFillResult must have "
   183	                    f"fill_origin='schwab_auto'; got {self.fill_origin!r}"
   184	                )
   185	        else:
   186	            if self.entry_date is not None:
   187	                raise ValueError(
   188	                    f"{self.kind!r} EntryAutoFillResult must not carry "
   189	                    f"entry_date; got {self.entry_date!r}"
   190	                )
   191	            if self.entry_price is not None:
   192	                raise ValueError(
   193	                    f"{self.kind!r} EntryAutoFillResult must not carry "
   194	                    f"entry_price; got {self.entry_price!r}"
   195	                )
   196	            if self.shares is not None:
   197	                raise ValueError(
   198	                    f"{self.kind!r} EntryAutoFillResult must not carry "
   199	                    f"shares; got {self.shares!r}"
   200	                )
   201	            if self.fill_origin != "operator_typed":
   202	                raise ValueError(
   203	                    f"{self.kind!r} EntryAutoFillResult must have "
   204	                    f"fill_origin='operator_typed'; got {self.fill_origin!r}"
   205	                )
   206

   209	    *,
   210	    ticker: str,
   211	    cfg: Any,
   212	    conn: Any,
   213	    now: datetime | None = None,
   214	    lookback_days: int = DEFAULT_LOOKBACK_DAYS,
   215	) -> EntryAutoFillResult:
   216	    """Resolve form-render-time entry auto-fill via Schwab Trader API.
   217	
   218	    See module docstring for the 4-step Schwab integration chain + short-

   220	
   221	    Args:
   222	        ticker: ticker to query (case-normalized to uppercase).
   223	        cfg: Config object; caller has already run apply_overrides(cfg)
   224	            at the handler entry (per spec §6.1 + plan §A.11).
   225	        conn: open DB connection (used for the DEGRADED predicate's
   226	            ``schwab_api_calls`` query + the ``trader.get_account_orders``
   227	            audit-row writes).
   228	        now: server-stamped 'now' for the lookback window + audit_at;
   229	            defaults to ``datetime.now(timezone.utc)``.
   230	        lookback_days: window for fill candidates; defaults to
   231	            ``DEFAULT_LOOKBACK_DAYS`` (7 days).
   232	
   233	    Returns:
   234	        ``EntryAutoFillResult`` — see dataclass docstring for the 5 kinds.
   235	    """
   236	    if not isinstance(ticker, str) or not ticker:
   237	        raise ValueError(
   238	            f"ticker must be non-empty str; got {ticker!r}"
   239	        )
   240	    ticker = ticker.upper()
   241	    if now is None:
   242	        now = datetime.now(UTC)
   243	    auto_fill_audit_at = now.isoformat(timespec="microseconds")
   244	
   245	    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
   246	    # Sandbox short-circuit per CLAUDE.md "Schwab sandbox-gating" gotcha.
   247	    # Fires BEFORE any Schwab client construction to keep the sandbox path
   248	    # provably side-effect-free.
   249	    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
   250	    schwab_cfg = getattr(getattr(cfg, "integrations", None), "schwab", None)
   251	    environment = getattr(schwab_cfg, "environment", None)
   252	    if environment == "sandbox":
   253	        return EntryAutoFillResult(
   254	            kind="sandbox_short_circuit",
   255	            fill_origin="operator_typed",
   256	            advisory_text=(
   257	                "Schwab integration in sandbox mode; auto-fill disabled. "
   258	                "Switch cfg.integrations.schwab.environment to 'production' "
   259	                "to enable."
   260	            ),
   261	            auto_fill_audit_at=auto_fill_audit_at,
   262	        )
   263	    if environment != "production":
   264	        # No Schwab cfg sub-namespace OR environment value not in V1 enum.
   265	        # Treat as DEGRADED for operator-facing consistency (the advisory
   266	        # text mentions cfg, not "sandbox" — operator can't enable
   267	        # auto-fill via sandbox mode).
   268	        return EntryAutoFillResult(
   269	            kind="degraded",
   270	            fill_origin="operator_typed",
   271	            advisory_text=(
   272	                "Schwab integration not configured "
   273	                "(cfg.integrations.schwab.environment missing or invalid). "
   274	                "Auto-fill unavailable."
   275	            ),
   276	            auto_fill_audit_at=auto_fill_audit_at,
   277	        )
   278	
   279	    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
   280	    # DEGRADED / PROVISIONAL short-circuit (mirrors `swing schwab status`
   281	    # predicate at cli_schwab._compute_degraded_state). LIVE proceeds;
   282	    # PROVISIONAL + DEGRADED both short-circuit with advisory.
   283	    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
   284	    tokens_path = _resolve_tokens_db_path(environment)
   285	    state, reason = _compute_degraded_state(
   286	        conn, env=environment, tokens_path=tokens_path, now=now,
   287	    )
   288	    if state != "LIVE":
   289	        return EntryAutoFillResult(
   290	            kind="degraded",
   291	            fill_origin="operator_typed",
   292	            advisory_text=(
   293	                f"Schwab integration {state.lower()}: "
   294	                f"{reason or 'unavailable'}. Auto-fill unavailable."
   295	            ),
   296	            auto_fill_audit_at=auto_fill_audit_at,
   297	        )
   298	
   299	    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
   300	    # account_hash resolution from cfg (V1: single linked account; per
   301	    # CLAUDE.md "Schwab CLIENT_ID + CLIENT_SECRET storage" + Sub-bundle B
   302	    # T-B.2 storage pattern).
   303	    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
   304	    account_hash = getattr(schwab_cfg, "account_hash", None)
   305	    if not account_hash or not isinstance(account_hash, str):
   306	        return EntryAutoFillResult(
   307	            kind="degraded",
   308	            fill_origin="operator_typed",
   309	            advisory_text=(
   310	                "Schwab account_hash not set; complete `swing schwab setup` "
   311	                "to link your account. Auto-fill unavailable."
   312	            ),
   313	            auto_fill_audit_at=auto_fill_audit_at,
   314	        )
   315	
   316	    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
   317	    # Credential resolution per CLAUDE.md gotcha "form-render-time prompts
   318	    # would block HTTP handler" — allow_prompt=False BINDING (BINDING per
   319	    # dispatch brief §5 watch item 4 + plan §A.11).
   320	    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
   321	    try:
   322	        client_id, client_secret = resolve_credentials_env_or_prompt(
   323	            cfg, environment, allow_prompt=False,
   324	        )
   325	    except SchwabConfigMissingError as exc:
   326	        return EntryAutoFillResult(
   327	            kind="degraded",
   328	            fill_origin="operator_typed",
   329	            advisory_text=(
   330	                f"Schwab credential resolution failed: {exc}. "
   680	
   681	
   682	-- ============================================================================
   683	-- 4. THE MINTING TRIGGER, and the BACKFILL.
   684	--
   685	-- A TRIGGER, NOT A SERVICE HOOK. A hook in record_intent or in the route is
   686	-- skippable and invisible to a raw INSERT -- the D36 shape. A trigger cannot be
   687	-- bypassed by any writer.
   688	--
   689	-- IT MUST BE INCAPABLE OF RAISING. Each copied value is guarded AT THE SOURCE
   690	-- by a CASE, so a junk fire lands NULL frozen values rather than aborting the
   691	-- operator's acceptance record.
   692	--
   693	-- THE TIER IS DERIVED, NEVER HARD-CODED (review 22A-R7-03). The specification
   694	-- for this trigger once read freeze_tier='live_at_acceptance' unconditionally,
   695	-- which would have given a POST-migration acceptance of a PRE-migration fire a
   696	-- false structural-proof label -- the exact defect the epoch exists to prevent,
   697	-- written into the epoch's own migration. It was the TWELFTH mirror site of the
   698	-- freeze-tier family and an eleven-site sweep could not have found it, because
   699	-- that sweep looked for the enum's VALUE SET and this line hard-coded ONE
   700	-- MEMBER of it. A value-set sweep does not find a hard-coded single member.
   701	-- The CASE below and the one in the backfill are the SQL twin of
   702	-- freeze_tier_for_candidate; a test runs both spellings over the same fixtures.
   703	-- ============================================================================
   704	CREATE TRIGGER trg_latch_link_mint_on_acceptance
   705	AFTER INSERT ON latch_order_intents
   706	FOR EACH ROW WHEN NEW.intent_kind = 'validity'
   707	             AND NEW.validity_outcome = 'accepted_by_broker'
   708	             AND NEW.actual_broker_order_id IS NOT NULL
   709	BEGIN
   710	    INSERT INTO latch_order_mandate_links (
   711	        validity_intent_id, place_intent_id, candidate_id, evaluation_run_id,
   712	        ticker, detection_date, broker_order_id,
   713	        frozen_pivot, frozen_invalidation, actual_quantity,
   714	        freeze_tier, linked_at)
   715	    SELECT NEW.intent_id,
   716	           NEW.validated_place_intent_id,
   717	           NEW.candidate_id,
   718	           NEW.evaluation_run_id,
   719	           NEW.ticker,
   720	           NEW.detection_date,
   721	           NEW.actual_broker_order_id,
   722	           CASE WHEN typeof(c.pivot) = 'real' AND c.pivot > 0
   723	                THEN c.pivot ELSE NULL END,
   724	           CASE WHEN typeof(c.initial_stop) = 'real' AND c.initial_stop > 0
   725	                THEN c.initial_stop ELSE NULL END,
   726	           NEW.actual_quantity,
   727	           CASE WHEN c.id > (SELECT max_candidate_id_at_barrier
   728	                               FROM candidates_immutability_epoch
   729	                              WHERE epoch_id = 1)
   730	                THEN 'live_at_acceptance' ELSE 'pre_barrier_reconstructed' END,
   731	           strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now')
   732	      FROM candidates c
   733	     WHERE c.id = NEW.candidate_id;
   734	END;
   735	
   736	-- THE BACKFILL is a GENERAL statement over the ledger, never a hand-written
   737	-- row, and it derives the tier through the SAME CASE rather than stating a
   738	-- constant -- the second single-member site the corrected sweep found. Its
   739	-- expected result on the live database today is exactly ONE row at
   740	-- pre_barrier_reconstructed, and the test asserts that as an OUTCOME of the
   741	-- derivation rather than as an input to it: the epoch was seeded from
   742	-- MAX(candidates.id) moments ago, so every candidate that exists is at-or-below
   743	-- the boundary and no backfilled link can be post-barrier.
   744	INSERT INTO latch_order_mandate_links (
   745	    validity_intent_id, place_intent_id, candidate_id, evaluation_run_id,
   746	    ticker, detection_date, broker_order_id,
   747	    frozen_pivot, frozen_invalidation, actual_quantity,
   748	    freeze_tier, linked_at)
   749	SELECT v.intent_id,
   750	       v.validated_place_intent_id,
   751	       v.candidate_id,
   752	       v.evaluation_run_id,
   753	       v.ticker,
   754	       v.detection_date,
   755	       v.actual_broker_order_id,
   756	       CASE WHEN typeof(c.pivot) = 'real' AND c.pivot > 0
   757	            THEN c.pivot ELSE NULL END,
   758	       CASE WHEN typeof(c.initial_stop) = 'real' AND c.initial_stop > 0
   759	            THEN c.initial_stop ELSE NULL END,
   760	       v.actual_quantity,
   761	       CASE WHEN c.id > (SELECT max_candidate_id_at_barrier
   762	                           FROM candidates_immutability_epoch
   763	                          WHERE epoch_id = 1)
   764	            THEN 'live_at_acceptance' ELSE 'pre_barrier_reconstructed' END,
   765	       strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now')
   766	  FROM latch_order_intents v
   767	  JOIN candidates c ON c.id = v.candidate_id
   768	 WHERE v.intent_kind = 'validity'
   769	   AND v.validity_outcome = 'accepted_by_broker'
   770	   AND v.actual_broker_order_id IS NOT NULL
   771	   AND v.validated_place_intent_id IS NOT NULL;
   772	
   773	-- ============================================================================
   774	-- 5. THE CORRECTION SURFACE LEARNS THE LATCH LADDER -- SIX ADD COLUMNs.
   775	--
   776	-- admission_tier takes a CONSTANT default, so NOT NULL DEFAULT is legal and the
   777	-- existing CADL row becomes 'last_word' -- which is true of it. The five
   778	-- citation columns default NULL, as SQLite requires for an added FK column.
   779	--
   780	-- The tier enum is TWO-VALUED in this arc; latch_ladder_tier2 arrives with
  2490	# in today's LATEST run the ordinary chain would write `pipeline_aplus` plus
  2491	# TODAY's candidate -- a DIFFERENT candidate from the mandate we know this fill
  2492	# came from.  Silent-wrong, not honest-NULL, and exactly what RD's trade-25
  2493	# standard forbids.
  2494	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  2495	def resolve_latched_provenance(
  2496	    conn,
  2497	    cfg,
  2498	    req,
  2499	    *,
  2500	    trade_id: int | None = None,
  2501	    exclude_trade_ids: frozenset[int] | None = None,
  2502	) -> LatchedProvenance:
  2503	    """The whole ladder for ONE entry request.
  2504	
  2505	    THE FILL SESSION IS `req.entry_date` AND NOTHING ELSE (S2.4.2, case 5c).
  2506	    It is the CORRECTED date the operator submitted -- not `trades.entry_date`,
  2507	    which on the correction path is the value being corrected, and not the wall
  2508	    clock. An implementation reading a different date probes a DIFFERENT WORLD
  2509	    and can admit a mandate that was dead when the fill actually happened.
  2510	
  2511	    `exclude_trade_ids` defaults to `None` and is then derived from `trade_id`.
  2512	    On the ENTRY path there is no row yet, so the set is empty; on the
  2513	    CORRECTION path the subject must be excluded or `_match_fill`'s windowed
  2514	    rung returns `clear_reason='fill'` for the very mandate it is being asked
  2515	    about (verified against the live DB).
  2516	    """
  2517	    envelope = getattr(req, "schwab_source_value_json", None)
  2518	    # THE INCONSISTENT EVIDENCE PAIR (RD, ruled on 22A-R3-13). See
  2519	    # `origin_and_envelope_are_inconsistent` for why this is the pair and never
  2520	    # the origin. The ENTRY proceeds; the keys land honest-unset; the warning
  2521	    # NAMES the inconsistency, so the operator adjudicates a legible anomaly
  2522	    # instead of inheriting a silent wrong label.
  2523	    #
  2524	    # EVERY NON-TRUSTED PATH IS UNTOUCHED, which is what bounds this: the
  2525	    # predicate returns False for `operator_typed`, so an ordinary hand-typed
  2526	    # entry with no envelope still returns `no_envelope`, unrecognised, and
  2527	    # runs the ordinary chain byte-for-byte.
  2528	    if origin_and_envelope_are_inconsistent(
  2529	            getattr(req, "fill_origin", "operator_typed"), envelope):
  2530	        log.warning(
  2531	            "22-A: fill for %s claims origin %r, which carries a Schwab "
  2532	            "envelope BY CONSTRUCTION, and its envelope is ABSENT (%r); no "
  2533	            "production writer produces that pair, so the envelope was "
  2534	            "stripped, tampered with or corrupted. The entry records with "
  2535	            "honest-unset cohort keys rather than with the latest run's "
  2536	            "candidate -- attributing it from a timing coincidence would be "
  2537	            "exactly the misattribution this surface exists to prevent. "
  2538	            "WARRANTS INVESTIGATION",
  2539	            req.ticker, getattr(req, "fill_origin", None), envelope)
  2540	        return LatchedProvenance(
  2541	            admitted=False, recognised_but_underivable=True,
  2542	            decline_reason="origin_envelope_inconsistent")
  2543	    if envelope is None:
  2544	        return LatchedProvenance(
  2545	            admitted=False, recognised_but_underivable=False,
  2546	            decline_reason="no_envelope")
  2547	
  2548	    # CANONICALITY IS ASKED OF THE ENVELOPE, BEFORE ANYTHING IS READ OUT OF IT
  2549	    # (self-sweep SS-1, a residual of 22A-R8-01 and 22A-R9-01).
  2550	    #
  2551	    # R9-01 moved this question above the link LOOKUP and left it below the
  2552	    # order-id READ. That is where a disagreeing envelope DISAPPEARS: an
  2553	    # envelope whose LAST duplicate key is null, numeric or blank gives the
  2554	    # Python reader None, and `no_order_id` is NOT recognised -- so the
  2555	    # ordinary chain wrote TODAY's candidate while `json_extract`, which keeps
  2556	    # the FIRST key, binds a real accepted mandate. MEASURED on three shapes.
  2557	    #
  2558	    # The guard's own subject is the DOCUMENT, not the identity it happens to
  2559	    # yield, so it runs first and it runs unconditionally.
  2560	    if not envelope_is_canonical(envelope):
  2561	        return LatchedProvenance(
  2562	            admitted=False, recognised_but_underivable=True,
  2563	            decline_reason="envelope_not_canonical")
  2564	
  2565	    broker_order_id = broker_order_id_from_envelope(envelope)
  2566	    if broker_order_id is None:
  2567	        return LatchedProvenance(
  2568	            admitted=False, recognised_but_underivable=False,
  2569	            decline_reason="no_order_id")
  2570	
  2571	    fill_session = _as_date(req.entry_date)
  2572	    if fill_session is None:
  2573	        # An order id WAS supplied, so this is a RECOGNISED request that cannot
  2574	        # be resolved -- it must not fall through to the ordinary chain as
  2575	        # though no order had been named.
  2576	        log.warning(
  2577	            "22-A: entry_date %r is not an ISO date; the latch probe cannot "
  2578	            "run and the entry records with honest-unset cohort keys",
  2579	            req.entry_date)
  2580	        return LatchedProvenance(
  2581	            admitted=False, recognised_but_underivable=True,
  2582	            decline_reason="fill_session_not_a_session")
  2583	
  2584	    # THE CONFIG GATE MOVED BELOW THE LINK LOOKUP (Codex 22A-R7-01), and the
  2585	    # move is what stops `cfg=None` being a FAIL-OPEN SWITCH.
  2586	    #
  2587	    # `cfg` is needed to DERIVE the fold, not to RECOGNISE the order -- the
  2588	    # envelope read and the link lookup need no configuration at all. Checked
  2589	    # FIRST, a caller who simply omitted the config sent an order-bearing fill
  2590	    # down the ORDINARY chain, which writes TODAY's candidate for a fill that
  2591	    # demonstrably came from an accepted order: the silent misattribution this
  2592	    # arc exists to prevent, reachable by leaving one keyword off.
  2593	    #
  2594	    # "Both production callers pass cfg" is a SERVICE-prevention argument, and
  2595	    # the reviewer's answer to it is right: the manifest test that pins those
  2596	    # two callers matches a syntactic NAME, so an alias, a wrapper or a future
  2597	    # consumer bypasses it while the asserted count stays two. A grep bounds a
  2598	    # family from below, and so does an AST walk keyed on a name.
  2599	    #
  2600	    # So the ladder now RECOGNISES first. No link -> `no_config` is still NOT
  2601	    # recognised and the ordinary path is intact, byte-for-byte, which is what
  2602	    # the LOCK is about. A link that EXISTS with no config is RECOGNISED and
  2603	    # refused, so the row lands honest-unset instead of wrong.
  2604	    # THE LOOKUP IS INSIDE THE CONTAINMENT (Codex 22A-R9-04, a residual of my
  2605	    # own 22A-R8-03 fix). The broad handler began at `authorize_accepted_order`
  2606	    # and `find_accepted_latch_order` ran BEFORE it -- so a SQLite read error
  2607	    # or a row-hydration failure escaped `resolve_latched_provenance` entirely
  2608	    # and `record_entry` rolled the trade and the fill back. The containment
  2609	    # test substituted `authorize_accepted_order` and therefore could not see
  2610	    # the hole: a boundary asserted at ONE call site is not a boundary.
  2611	    #
  2612	    # Fail-CLOSED and RECOGNISED: the request carries a usable order id, so a
  2613	    # lookup we could not perform is IGNORANCE about a real order, never
  2614	    # licence to write TODAY's candidate.
  2615	    try:
  2616	        orders = find_accepted_latch_order(
  2617	            conn, broker_order_id=broker_order_id)
  2618	    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 -- ignorance, not a crash
  2619	        log.exception(
  2620	            "22-A: the link lookup for broker order %s RAISED; the entry "
  2621	            "records with honest-unset cohort keys rather than being blocked, "
  2622	            "and this WARRANTS INVESTIGATION", broker_order_id)
  2623	        return LatchedProvenance(
  2624	            admitted=False, recognised_but_underivable=True,
  2625	            decline_reason="aliveness_unverifiable")
  2626	    if orders and cfg is None:
  2627	        log.warning(
  2628	            "22-A: broker order %s names %d accepted latch link(s) but NO "
  2629	            "config was supplied, so the mandate cannot be derived; the entry "
  2630	            "records with honest-unset cohort keys rather than with TODAY's "
  2631	            "candidate", broker_order_id, len(orders))
  2632	        return LatchedProvenance(
  2633	            admitted=False, recognised_but_underivable=True,
  2634	            decline_reason="no_config", order=orders[0])
  2635	    if cfg is None:
  2636	        # A DISTINCT REASON, NOT A SHARED ONE (case 18). "No config" and "no
  2637	        # order id" are different ignorances, and an operator reading the log
  2638	        # needs to know which one happened. NOT recognised: no link names this
  2639	        # order, so the ordinary chain runs exactly as it does on `main`.
  2640	        return LatchedProvenance(
  2641	            admitted=False, recognised_but_underivable=False,
  2642	            decline_reason="no_config")
  2643	    if not orders:
  2644	        # NOT recognised: no link names this order, so the ordinary chain runs
  2645	        # exactly as it does on `main`. This is the ONLY refusal after an order
  2646	        # id was found that leaves the ordinary path intact.
  2647	        return LatchedProvenance(
  2648	            admitted=False, recognised_but_underivable=False,
  2649	            decline_reason="no_accepted_latch_order")
  2650	    if len(orders) > 1:
  2651	        log.warning(
  2652	            "22-A: broker order %s names %d links (%s); cardinality is the "
  2653	            "READER's count and two is not one",
  2654	            broker_order_id, len(orders), [o.link_id for o in orders])
  2655	        return LatchedProvenance(
  2656	            admitted=False, recognised_but_underivable=True,
  2657	            decline_reason="ambiguous_accepted_orders")
  2658	
  2659	    order = orders[0]
  2660	    if exclude_trade_ids is not None:
  2661	        excluded = frozenset(exclude_trade_ids)
  2662	    elif trade_id is not None:
  2663	        excluded = frozenset({trade_id})
  2664	    else:
  2665	        excluded = frozenset()
  2666	    # THE INVARIANT FAILURES ARE CONTAINED HERE (Codex 22A-R7-02).
  2667	    # `LatchProbeInvariantError` is raised DELIBERATELY at two points inside
  2668	    # the probe -- a `criteria_lapsed` terminal the rung was FORCED OFF, and a
  2669	    # terminal dated LATER than the fill -- and both sit AFTER the broad
  2670	    # fail-soft handler around `build_latch_derivation`. Nothing between here
  2671	    # and `record_entry` catches a `RuntimeError`, so the transaction rolled
  2672	    # back and NO TRADE AND NO FILL LANDED.
  2673	    #
  2674	    # The code's own message for those states is that the COHORT PROBE
  2675	    # MALFUNCTIONED. Turning a probe malfunction into a blocked broker fill is
  2676	    # COHORT-GUARD REFUSES: LABEL -- the containment sits at the RESOLVER's
  2677	    # boundary, so a fifth invariant added later is contained by construction.
  2678	    # the `0036:26-38` inversion in its purest form -- and the arc has now met
  2679	    # it four times, which is why the containment is placed at the RESOLVER's
  2680	    # boundary rather than at each raise site: a fifth invariant added later is
  2681	    # contained by construction.
  2682	    #
  2683	    # THE RAISES ARE NOT REMOVED and their tests are unchanged: they are how a
  2684	    # probe defect becomes LOUD at the probe grain. What changes is that the
  2685	    # ENTRY does not pay for it. Fail-CLOSED -- `aliveness_unverifiable` can
  2686	    # never admit -- and the log carries the exception type and a traceback so
  2687	    # a real defect is investigated rather than absorbed.
  2688	    #
  2689	    # SELF-SWEEP SS-22A-FIX-1 (the class Codex 22A-FIX-R3-01 / -R4-03 named,
  2690	    # re-grepped rather than fixed one instance at a time).  `float(x)` is not
  2691	    # a type test, and `fills.price` / `fills.quantity` are REAL columns
  2692	    # SQLite does not apply affinity to -- so a numeric-LOOKING BLOB is
  2693	    # schema-legal under their `> 0` CHECKs, converts cleanly, and reaches the
  2694	    # evidence blob as `bytes` where `json.dumps` dies and the citation
  2695	    # trigger's `json_type` binding refuses.  The SAME authorize-then-abort,
  2696	    # on the REQUEST's operands rather than on the link's frozen ones.
  2697	    #
  2698	    # It is a REFUSAL, never an exception: the guard returns the reasons the
  2699	    # ladder already owns for these two operands, so the entry still records
  2700	    # honest-unset instead of paying for cohort bookkeeping.
  2701	    if (isinstance(req.entry_price, bool)
  2702	            or not isinstance(req.entry_price, (int, float))
  2703	            or not math.isfinite(float(req.entry_price))):
  2704	        log.warning(
  2705	            "22-A: the fill's price for %s is %s, not a finite number; the "
  2706	            "mandate cannot be judged against it and the entry records with "
  2707	            "honest-unset cohort keys",
  2708	            req.ticker, type(req.entry_price).__name__)
  2709	        return _refuse("fill_outside_frozen_zone", order,
  2710	                       freeze_tier=order.freeze_tier)
  2711	    if (isinstance(req.shares, bool)
  2712	            or not isinstance(req.shares, (int, float))

  2685	            seq.append(name)
  2686	            return real(*a, **kw)
  2687	        return wrapper
  2688	
  2689	    for name in ("ensure_entry_fill_identities", "consuming_entry_fills",
  2690	                 "unreadable_entry_fills"):
  2691	        monkeypatch.setattr(fei, name, _spy(name, getattr(fei, name)))
  2692	
  2693	    conn, cfg, candidate_id = build_world(tmp_path, "ss15")
  2694	    accept_and_link(conn, candidate_id, session=ACCEPT_SESSION)
  2695	    conn.commit()
  2696	    enter(conn, cfg, req())
  2697	
  2698	    assert seq, "no scan ran; this world does not reach rung 6"
  2699	    assert seq[0] == "ensure_entry_fill_identities", (
  2700	        f"a scan ran before the population was established: {seq}")
  2701	    assert "ensure_entry_fill_identities" not in seq[1:], (
  2702	        f"the population pass ran more than once inside one ladder: {seq}")
  2703	
  2704	
  2705	# ===========================================================================
  2706	# THE ENTRY-OR-LABEL SEAM, ENFORCED RATHER THAN DECLARED (RD, ruled twice;
  2707	# violated FOUR times in this arc -- `NotSessionError`, 37c, `R11-02`'s
  2708	# uncontained `record_identity`, and the entry route's `schwab_order_id` rung)
  2709	#
  2710	# **THAT IS NOT FOUR SLIPS; IT IS A DEFAULT THAT MUST BE INVERTED AT THE SEAM.**
  2711	# Every guard written to protect the cohort keys defaulted to blocking the
  2712	# ENTRY, and each was found individually, by a different reviewer, on a
  2713	# different round.  A standing requirement that each guard STATE which of ENTRY
  2714	# or LABEL it refuses is a prose rule, and a prose rule is exactly what the
  2715	# four instances each satisfied in spirit and broke in code.
  2716	#
  2717	# So the seam carries a PROPERTY instead: **for EVERY member of
  2718	# `DECLINE_REASONS`, in BOTH recognition states, the trade row is still
  2719	# WRITTEN.**  A fifth guard added anywhere in the resolution -- whatever it is
  2720	# called, whatever it refuses over -- fails here the moment it prevents the
  2721	# row, without anyone having to notice it was a cohort guard.
  2722	# ===========================================================================
  2723	def _every_refusal_still_writes(tmp_path, monkeypatch, *, recognised: bool,
  2724	                               pe_anchored: bool):
  2725	    """``pe_anchored`` ARMS THE RELOCATED PE-ANCHOR GUARD, and without it this
  2726	    property could not have caught the instance it is written for.
  2727	
  2728	    37c's guard fires only when a `pattern_evaluation_id` anchor is present
  2729	    AND the server-derived origin is `manual_off_pipeline`; a bare request
  2730	    never meets it, so a seam property run only on bare requests would have
  2731	    gone green against the very code RD ruled against.  Both request shapes
  2732	    run -- the BOTH-MODES requirement applied to the arming condition rather
  2733	    than to a config flag.
  2734	    """
  2735	    from swing.trades import latched_origin as lo
  2736	
  2737	    name = f"seam{int(recognised)}{int(pe_anchored)}"
  2738	    if pe_anchored:
  2739	        conn, cfg, candidate_id = _pe_anchored_world(
  2740	            tmp_path, name, closes=BASE_CLOSES)
  2741	    else:
  2742	        conn, cfg, candidate_id = build_world(tmp_path, name)
  2743	    accept_and_link(conn, candidate_id, session=ACCEPT_SESSION)
  2744	    conn.commit()
  2745	    if pe_anchored:
  2746	        from swing.trades.origin import derive_trade_origin
  2747	        assert derive_trade_origin(
  2748	            conn, TICKER, EntryPath.MANUAL_WEB_FORM) == "manual_off_pipeline", (
  2749	            "the PE-anchor guard's third condition is unmet, so this arming "
  2750	            "proves nothing")
  2751	
  2752	    written_rows: dict[str, tuple] = {}
  2753	    for reason in sorted(lo.DECLINE_REASONS):
  2754	        def _refuse(_conn, _cfg, _req, reason=reason):
  2755	            return lo.LatchedProvenance(
  2756	                admitted=False, recognised_but_underivable=recognised,
  2757	                decline_reason=reason)
  2758	
  2759	        monkeypatch.setattr(lo, "resolve_latched_provenance", _refuse)
  2760	        monkeypatch.setattr(
  2761	            "swing.trades.entry.resolve_latched_provenance", _refuse,
  2762	            raising=False)
  2763	        result = enter(conn, cfg, req(
  2764	            hypothesis_label="a submitted label",
  2765	            **({"pattern_evaluation_id": 7} if pe_anchored else {})))
  2766	        assert result.trade_id is not None, reason
  2767	        written_rows[reason] = written(conn, result.trade_id)
  2768	        # ONE OPEN POSITION PER TICKER is a PRE-EXISTING production gate
  2769	        # (`ux_trades_one_open_per_ticker`, migration 0014) and has nothing to
  2770	        # do with cohort bookkeeping, so the row is removed between reasons
  2771	        # rather than the world rebuilt thirty-six times.  Raw, because the
  2772	        # row's existence is what was just measured and its disposal is not
  2773	        # part of the property.
  2774	        conn.execute("DELETE FROM fills WHERE trade_id = ?",
  2775	                     (result.trade_id,))
  2776	        conn.execute("DELETE FROM trades WHERE id = ?", (result.trade_id,))
  2777	        conn.commit()
  2778	    conn.close()
  2779	    return written_rows
  2780	
  2781	
  2782	@pytest.mark.parametrize("pe_anchored", [False, True],
  2783	                         ids=["bare", "pe-anchored"])
  2784	def test_EVERY_refusal_reason_still_writes_the_entry_recognised(
  2785	        tmp_path, monkeypatch, pe_anchored) -> None:
  2786	    """RECOGNISED-AND-REFUSED: the row lands HONEST-UNSET for every reason.
  2787	
  2788	    Honest-unset is `('manual_off_pipeline', None, None)` -- all three keys
  2789	    move together, because a row carrying origin and candidate but a NULL
  2790	    label is incoherent AND permanently uncorrectable (Demand C's
  2791	    `_gate_on_unset_state` refuses a trade carrying any of the three).
  2792	    """
  2793	    rows = _every_refusal_still_writes(
  2794	        tmp_path, monkeypatch, recognised=True, pe_anchored=pe_anchored)
  2795	    assert rows, "no reason was exercised, so this row measures nothing"
  2796	    for reason, row in rows.items():
  2797	        assert row == ("manual_off_pipeline", None, None), (
  2798	            f"refusal {reason!r} did not land honest-unset: {row}")
  2799	
  2800	
  2801	def test_EVERY_refusal_reason_still_writes_the_entry_fall_through(
  2802	        tmp_path, monkeypatch) -> None:
  2803	    """NOT-RECOGNISED: the ordinary chain runs and the row is still written.
  2804	
  2805	    The two recognition states are exercised separately because they take
  2806	    DIFFERENT branches -- suppression versus fall-through -- and a guard added
  2807	    to either one would be invisible to a test that only ran the other.
  2808	
  2809	    **THE PE-ANCHORED SHAPE IS DELIBERATELY NOT RUN HERE, AND ITS ABSENCE IS A
  2810	    RULING RATHER THAN A GAP** -- see the declared exception below.  A
  2811	    parametrization that ran it would assert the opposite of what RD ruled.
  2812	    """
  2813	    rows = _every_refusal_still_writes(
  2814	        tmp_path, monkeypatch, recognised=False, pe_anchored=False)

  2817	        assert row[0] is not None, (
  2818	            f"refusal {reason!r} blocked the entry; cohort bookkeeping never "
  2819	            f"blocks a money-bearing entry")

  1318	# ===========================================================================
  1319	# CODEX 22A-R4-03 -- a commit that RAISES must still roll back
  1320	#
  1321	# `conn.commit()` sat in the `else:` clause, OUTSIDE the `except BaseException:`
  1322	# handler, so a busy / disk-full / I-O failure at commit left the transaction
  1323	# AND its write reservation open on a connection the caller goes on reusing.
  1324	# ===========================================================================
  1325	class _CommitRaises:
  1326	    """A connection whose COMMIT fails and whose ROLLBACK is observable.
  1327	
  1328	    Only the four members `_entry_transaction` touches are proxied; anything
  1329	    else raises `AttributeError` loudly rather than silently degrading, so the
  1330	    stand-in cannot quietly diverge from the real connection's surface.
  1331	    """
  1332	
  1333	    def __init__(self, conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:
  1334	        self._conn = conn
  1335	        self.rolled_back = False
  1336	
  1337	    def execute(self, *args, **kwargs):
  1338	        return self._conn.execute(*args, **kwargs)
  1339	
  1340	    def commit(self) -> None:
  1341	        raise sqlite3.OperationalError("disk I/O error")
  1342	
  1343	    def rollback(self) -> None:
  1344	        self.rolled_back = True
  1345	        self._conn.rollback()
  1346	
  1347	    @property
  1348	    def in_transaction(self) -> bool:
  1349	        return self._conn.in_transaction
  1350	
  1351

  1356	
  1357	    The exception itself propagates either way, so asserting only the raise
  1358	    would pass under both paths.
  1359	    """

  2115	# ===========================================================================
  2116	# 22A-FIX-R2-03 / -04 -- THE ACQUISITION WINDOW, AND THE APPLY PATH'S OWN
  2117	# CLEANUP FAILURE
  2118	#
  2119	# `BEGIN DEFERRED` / `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` sat OUTSIDE their `try` blocks, so an
  2120	# interrupt landing between the statement OPENING the transaction and the
  2121	# `try` being entered skipped the handler entirely -- and on the apply path the
  2122	# WRITE RESERVATION stayed held.  The R15-03 row could not reach that window
  2123	# because it raises from inside `_correct_cohort_provenance_inner`.
  2124	#
  2125	# And the apply path still SUPPRESSED a failing rollback, which is the exact
  2126	# composition the preview path declares more dangerous four commits earlier --
  2127	# `AL-15`'s standard held for the dry run and not for the path that writes.
  2128	# ===========================================================================
  2129	class _InterruptAtAcquisitionConn:
  2130	    """Delegates everything; performs the REAL ``BEGIN`` and then interrupts.
  2131	
  2132	    The BEGIN is issued before raising, so the connection is genuinely IN a
  2133	    transaction when the handler runs -- which is the whole point.  A proxy
  2134	    that merely raised INSTEAD of beginning would test a different window.
  2135	    """
  2136	
  2137	    def __init__(self, real: sqlite3.Connection, verb: str) -> None:
  2138	        self._real = real
  2139	        self._verb = verb
  2140	        self.began = False
  2141	        # The SQL actually issued, because the savepoint's name is now
  2142	        # PER-INVOCATION (22A-FIX-R4-01) and a test cannot spell it in advance.
  2143	        self.began_sql: str | None = None
  2144	
  2145	    def __getattr__(self, name):
  2146	        return getattr(self._real, name)
  2147	
  2148	    def execute(self, sql, *args):
  2149	        if sql.startswith(self._verb):
  2150	            self._real.execute(sql, *args)
  2151	            self.began = True
  2152	            self.began_sql = sql
  2153	            raise KeyboardInterrupt(f"planted just after {self._verb}")
  2154	        return self._real.execute(sql, *args)
  2155	
  2156

  2230	@contextlib.contextmanager
  2231	def caplog_at_error():
  2232	    """A minimal ERROR-record collector.
  2233	
  2234	    `caplog` is not used because this module's other rows do not take it and
  2235	    the collection is three lines; the point is only that the log line exists.
  2236	    """
  2237	    import logging
  2238	
  2239	    records: list[logging.LogRecord] = []
  2240	
  2241	    class _Sink(logging.Handler):
  2242	        def emit(self, record):
  2243	            records.append(record)
  2244	
  2245	    sink = _Sink(level=logging.ERROR)
  2246	    root = logging.getLogger()
  2247	    root.addHandler(sink)
  2248	    try:
  2249	        yield records
  2250	    finally:
  2251	        root.removeHandler(sink)
  2252	
  2253

  2255	# 22A-FIX-R3-04 / -05 / -06 -- THE THIRD SITE, AND THE SAVEPOINT THE CALLER
  2256	# WAS LEFT HOLDING
  2257	# ===========================================================================
  2258	def test_R3M4_the_READER_does_not_leak_its_read_transaction_at_acquisition(
  2259	        conn) -> None:
  2260	    """A THIRD site of the acquisition-window class, not the settled
  2261	    `_entry_transaction` one.
  2262	
  2263	    A library caller reusing the connection would inherit a read transaction
  2264	    it did not open -- a stale WAL snapshot, and a later transaction-owning

  2337	def test_R4M1_the_savepoint_name_is_PER_INVOCATION(conn) -> None:
  2338	    """A FIXED NAME IS A COLLISION WAITING FOR A CALLER (Codex 22A-FIX-R4-01,
  2339	    verified by execution against real SQLite savepoint behaviour).
  2340	
  2341	    When this call runs inside a caller-held transaction and its own
  2342	    ``SAVEPOINT`` fails BEFORE taking effect, the acquisition recovery's
  2343	    ``ROLLBACK TO`` / ``RELEASE`` targeted whatever savepoint of that name
  2344	    already existed -- **the CALLER'S** -- discarding unrelated caller work
  2345	    and releasing a nesting level it owns.
  2390	# `cohort_provenance_correction.py` now takes `BaseException`.
  2391	#
  2392	# These rows carry SS ids and no round number: they are the sweep's, and the
  2393	# sweep does not count toward convergence.
  2394	# ===========================================================================
  2395	class _InterruptOnRollback:
  2396	    """Delegates everything; performs the REAL rollback and then interrupts."""
  2397	
  2398	    def __init__(self, real: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:
  2399	        self._real = real
  2400	        self.rolled = False
  2401	
  2402	    def __getattr__(self, name):
  2403	        return getattr(self._real, name)
  2404	
  2405	    def rollback(self):
  2406	        self._real.rollback()
  2407	        self.rolled = True
  2408	        raise KeyboardInterrupt("planted just after rollback")
  2409	
  2410
